label: PF Backlog 698
title: Knowledge Authority & Conflict Resolution: hierarchy enforcement, contradiction detection, and fail-closed HIL escalation
body:
## Problem / why
Conflicting rules or stale memory entries injected into prompts confuse the model, leading to silent drift and hallucination.

## Goal & value
Enforce strict authority ordering (SSOT > ADR > Decision > Learned) and fail-closed contradiction detection before context enters prompts.

## Reference Documents
- `docs/Product_Forge_RAG_CAG_Knowledge_Fabric_Integration.md#section-15`
- `docs/RAG-PROCESS-MEMORY.md#section-6`

## In scope
- Authority hierarchy evaluator.
- Contradiction detection between candidate chunks and active SSOT rules.
- Fail-closed escalation halting injection on unresolvable same-tier contradictions.

## Out of scope
- Silent automated resolution of contradictory high-level business requirements.

## Definition of Done
- Contradiction tests verify fail-closed escalation and proper authority override.

## Verification
Structured `acceptance_criteria` is the single source of truth for verification.
